ceilings.title: NN300 / Treaty ceilings
ceilings.description: A contract whose "Sum Insured" exceeds the NN300 ceiling is automatically submitted as a draft for validation by the Group (DTAG). Once validated, its certificates are covered up to the Treaty Ceiling with no further escalation.
ceilings.treatyHint: Beyond this, an alert is raised for facultative reinsurance placement.
